scenes.headline: Your site has 2.5 seconds.
scenes.body: That’s Google’s bar for a “good” load.

scenes.headline:
Main content in
≤ 2.5 s.
scenes.body: Usually your hero image or headline. Over 4 s is poor.

scenes.headline:
React to taps in
≤ 200 ms.
scenes.body: Every click, tap and key press, across the whole visit.

scenes.headline:
Nothing jumps.
CLS ≤ 0.1.
scenes.body: Content that shifts while loading costs clicks and trust.

scenes.headline: Smaller images. Less JavaScript. Reserved space.
scenes.body: WebP or AVIF heroes, late-loaded widgets, sized media.

scenes.headline: DM us “SPEED”.
scenes.body: Performance is built into every website we ship.
